title: Implement privacy-governed L7 daily model candidate training and feedback loop
whatBuilt: ELIGIBLE DATA ONLY: corpus from the VMM-03 seed registry's TRAINABLE records — revoked sources excluded (revocation lineage), benchmark-contaminated records refused (poison test), RETENTION bound excludes records older than the pre-declared 365-day window, rights-missing refused; corpus digest binds the exact eligible set

REPRODUCIBLE BOUNDED EXERCISE: one candidate trained from scratch (VMM-08 semantics) with a recorded manifest; exercise bounded (max samples/epochs); same seed -> identical training curve; loss decreases
LINEAGE: dataset -> candidate chain complete with digests (VMM-02 manifests)

RELEASE PATHS: evaluation through the VMM-04 registry (custodian decides); PROMOTE requires a VMM-10 custodian approval bound to an accepted report; HOLD keeps the candidate registered-but-unapproved; ROLLBACK returns serving to an earlier APPROVED version
PERSONAL STATE REMAINS DISTINCT: no adaptation-state API exists on the pipeline (contract-proven) — global weights and personal adaptation are separate namespaces
